original_card.question: Does a changed construction's serialized target/paid invoice independently support its claimed improvement?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read revision 8, the selected review and live exact-source handoffs. Then follow this card's bounded first_experiment.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only, not a supplier replay or theorem proof.

original_card.first_experiment: Independently recount one changed emitted word and its complete caller, importing no constructor or pricing engine. Include target losses, owned lifetimes, native orientation and extra charges. Check existing #5633/#5708/#5717/#5719 coverage to avoid duplicate audits and preserve its exact head. Stop after the chosen missing implication; a correct root alone is not supplier admission.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.
allowed_variations: One exact source head, helper/cut region or quantified proposition and changed hypothesis; check live handoffs first. Different seeds are not different scopes.
scope_change_triggers: Changing source head, helper/cut domain, operation alphabet or caller boundary without recording the new scope.
Treating an archived proposal or local numerical pass as complete supplier admission.

actual_scope: Independent recount, at the exact open PR heads #7631 2f1cc8c0f8c281afd2f99aeeeae6153e269f4721 and #7633 8b885be4a553dea375303808fdfff52ed0d71019, of two successive links (the #7631 source word to the #7631 word, and that word to the #7633 word): (1) header and initial-chart changes, (2) the chart chronology of all three complete words, (3) the MOVE rank histograms and their relation to the declared 17-call paid invoices, (4) the helper target ranks and their relation to the declared target invoices, and (5) the signs of the declared complete moments at the claims, the raw brackets and the #7627 value. The canonical digests of the two #7633 words are compared with the ones its README states. No constructor, application or pricing engine of the PRs is imported.
scope_change_reason: The first experiment of the card is applied to newer exact heads. No audit of #7633 or #7631 was found among the open PRs on 2026-11-17. The #7633 source word is byte-equal to the #7631 candidate word, so one package covers both links. #7633 builds on the role-457 mechanism of #7630 and carries a common whole-private-extent supplier premise that this audit does not touch.
bottleneck_link: The complex supplier binds. #7631 and #7633 change paid MOVE ranks of the P104 word, and #7633 also changes one helper target. Each invoice is built from the previous one plus a declared change. This audit binds both sides of each change to the emitted word bytes.
stop_rule: Stop after the word-to-invoice binding and the moment signs of the two links are resolved or one exact mismatch is found. Do not replay the native, signed, physical, ordinary, supplier or outer stages.
evidence: verify.py passes on CPython 3.13.9 (Windows) in about 2 s: for both links paid = 17 x (MOVE rank histogram of the word) + one fixed caller histogram, equal to the ones of the #7612 and #7630 recounts; targets = 17 x (helper target histogram) + one fixed caller target histogram; the native deltas {2:-1,3:-1,5:+1} and {3:-1} and the helper delta {6:+1,9:-1} are recounted from the words; all three words have a legal chart chronology; the canonical digests equal the two that the #7633 README states; the moment signs agree with the PRs at 14 points; the derivative bounds equal the values in the #7633 price file; and 18 controls reject.
